C1155.title: Kuaishou Warned by Public Security for Inadequate Youth Mode Implementation
C1155.summary: Kuaishou was issued a warning by public security authorities under the Cybersecurity Law after illegal content on its short-video platform spread due to insufficient enforcement of its youth mode, harming minors' physical and mental health. The company was ordered to conduct a comprehensive review and removal of the illegal information.
